Genuinamente um dos melhores jogos que já joguei.
Consegue se manter divertido do início ao fim, tem um estilo bacana e fresco, trilha sonora agradável.
Os puzzles não são o forte, mas não é um jogo de puzzle, então não me aborreceu.
O jogo tem várias dinâmicas diferentes, nas lutas de boss, nos upgrades e na exploração. Da para se entreter por horas. Super recomendo!!

Honestly, this game was such a pleasant surprise to me.  The trailers on the store page could not have prepared me for how much this game has to offer.  The pixel graphics and 3d art combo (done flawlessly in my opinion), the goofy and charming characters, and the many things to do.  Just when I thought I was getting bored of the repetition, the game would throw a new mechanic at me.  I found myself addicted to seeing all through all of it.  This is easily one of my favorite games now and it caught me completely by surprise.  Please go into this game blind if you can because it will surprise you with laughs and creativity at every turn.

This game is absolutely amazing.
From the moment I started the game I was imersed in its rich story and complex characters that in the 6 hours I've played have yet to let me down and bored me.
Every inch of this game is incredibly fun and exciting, from the diving itself to the sushi restaurant or all the mission and story that comes along.
Although I've loved this game so far, there are some issues that bother me a bit for example: the bosses I've played so far were all really easy to beat, and they all hade great mechanics so if they all were a little harder it would have been much better. Other issue I had was all the dialogue, I don't really mind the dialogue in games but sometimes in this one were too much, an example of this Is the back story of the chef, I mostly skipped trough it and at the end I still understood the plot that was training to show me.
This are only minor issues compared to the greatness of the game.
Finally I completely recommend this game to anyone who likes good and fun rpgs that you can't really stop playing.

If you're looking for a good laugh, then you must check out the witty scripts in this game. You'll love how everyone pushes Dave around which always makes me giggle. Despite all the negative comments about him, Dave still helps everyone out, which is commendable. The reactions of other NPCs to the food are hilarious and it reminds me of an anime series I watched before, Yakitate Japan. Trust me, you won't be able to resist the overall experience and I highly recommend that you give it a try.

Great little indie game about spear fishing and running your own restaurant. Little difficult to understand at the beginning but it helps if you know how a restaurant works lol. Amazing sound track really helps with the atmosphere and, can really put you on edge sometimes. I reccomend this game if you like simulation games or management type games for instance: JWE or the oldskool money making games. The artsyle is also wonderful combining pixel art with almost 3d graphics is a combo that works very well in this setting, making the player feel at home and warm. Big stardew valley type vibes from this experience. thank you for making this game when every other game i got bored of (rip overwatch).

Cant wait until the full version is released!!
